PROJECT.STARTUPSTORA: select ' ' as [Suma0700],t.opis as [Trgovina1800], s.opis as [Skladište1800], g.datumdok as [Datum1000], g.broj as Dokument, r.userid as [Sifra1000],r.naziv as [Roba4500], d.KolicinaUlaz as [Količina1000] , j.naziv as [JM0700],d.MPcijena, d.MPVrijednost from maloprodajagla g inner join maloprodajadet d on g.maloprodajaglaid=d.maloprodajaglaid inner join trgovina t on g.trgovinaid=t.trgovinaid inner join roba r on d.robaid=r.robaid inner join jm j on r.jmid = j.jmid left join skladiste s on g.skladisteid=s.skladisteid where g.vrstadokid in (select vrstadokid from vrstadok where vrstapromid in (select vrstapromid from vrstaprom where sifra='104')) and g.status=1 and dbo.fnMPDajSktId(1,g.maloprodajaglaid) is not null order by t.opis,r.naziv
